rca of the issue: Previous fix (iter73x) only added indexes; production still hung because _seller_snapshots issued a giant $or across 4 key classes combined with a sort that forced Mongo to walk up to 8000 fat product_snapshots docs. iter73y (a) discovers (store_id,sku) pairs per-key-class using tiny indexed aggregations, then (b) does one bounded index-backed read per pair with maxTimeMS=8000 and a lean projection; (c) rebuilds every index (including previously-unindexed product_matches) via INDEX_SPECS; (d) data-freshness switched from a whole-collection $group to per-store indexed reads; (e) frontend gains 45s timeout + explicit error state + Retry so the panel can never sit on 'Loading...' forever. Verified in this iteration.
